title: Apple
body:
"Apples are sweet, delicious fruit."

Description

The Apple is an item that can be found on Oak trees ranging from 2-5 apples per tree.

It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $150 per Apple. In its jam form it may be sold for $600.

Grants a small health boost when eaten.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~1.74% per apple.
